subject: Nov 18 site tour + technical walkthrough — coverage options
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>

Subject: Nov 18 site tour + technical walkthrough — coverage options

Hi Megan —

Thanks again for booking the site tour on Nov 18. Quick note to share the planned agenda and confirm a couple logistics so we can avoid any last-minute scrambling: attached is a short agenda (agenda.pdf).

High-level plan (Nov 18):
- 2:00–3:00pm PT: Onsite deep-dive + systems walkthrough (your team in the server room)
- 3:00–3:30pm PT: Live Q&A with decision makers in conference room B
- 3:30–4:00pm PT: Executive summary + next steps

A couple asks from our side:
1) Can you confirm Dr. Park's expected arrival time?
2) Are there any access badges or escort requirements we should know about?

If anything has changed travel-wise we can either: 1) move the walkthrough to Nov 19 AM, or 2) run the walkthrough as planned but record the session + host a shorter live Q&A later the same day (4:00pm PT) so Dr. Park can join asynchronously. Both options are workable — happy to coordinate whichever fits your schedule.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

— Alex

Subject: Re: Nov 18 site tour + technical walkthrough — coverage options

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the agenda. Heads-up: travel changed on our side — I have to travel to a field event and will be in transit most of Nov 18. Dr. Park is booked on an early morning flight and will only be on site briefly around 10:30am before heading to another meeting.

Options that would work for us:
- Move the onsite walkthrough to Nov 19 AM (Dr. Park is available all morning)
- Keep Nov 18 but convert the technical walkthrough to a recorded session you run with Jordan (who can be onsite) and then host a 30-min live Q&A at 4:00pm PT so leadership can join remotely after travel

If you think Jordan can cover the hands-on portion we’re fine with the recorded + live Q&A route — we just need a clear handoff so nothing is missed. Attached is my updated travel itinerary for reference.

Appreciate the flexibility.

Best,
Megan

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Nov 18 site tour + technical walkthrough — coverage options

Thanks Megan — and appreciate the heads-up. Proposal below so we can lock a plan quickly:

Plan A (preferred if your team can): Move to Nov 19 9:00–11:30am PT — full onsite walkthrough + executive time. This keeps the hands-on walkthrough and gives Dr. Park an uninterrupted block.

Plan B (fallthrough — keeps Nov 18 date):
- 2:00–3:00pm PT: Jordan will run the hands-on walkthrough onsite and record the full session (we’ll provide an edited 15–20 minute highlights video).
- 4:00–4:30pm PT: Live Q&A (remote) where Dr. Park and other execs can join. We’ll have a short pre-read and the highlights video ready 45 minutes before the live Q&A.

Mutual action items if Plan B:
- Jordan (internal) to confirm onsite equipment and recording kit — will use the attached handoff checklist.
- Alex to produce the highlights video and upload to the shared Drive; Camila to prepare the one-pager (security/compliance bullets) for the execs.
- Megan to confirm remote dial-in for 4:00pm PT and whether there are any AV restrictions at the site.

Jordan — can you confirm you’re available Nov 18 and OK to run the onsite session if needed? If not, we’ll prioritize moving to Nov 19.

If you’re ok with Plan B, I’ll schedule the recording slot and share links/credentials. Thanks all.

— Alex

Attachments: handoff-checklist.md (text checklist)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>

I can take Nov 18 onsite if Plan B is the final choice — confirmed availability. Quick notes:
- I’ll arrive at the Horizon lobby by 1:30pm PT to set up.
- I’ll bring the recording kit and a spare laptop; will capture the full walkthrough and a 20-minute highlights reel.
- I’ll run through the handoff checklist before we start and ping Alex if anything looks off.

Camila — I’ll need the compliance one-pager by 2:45pm so I can reference it during the exec summary.

Megan — please send the building AV contact (if any) and confirm where you want the recording files uploaded after the session. I’ll also share a short checklist for the on-site contact to sign off.

Thanks — Jordan
